records.name: Booth
records.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one production game UI icon, not a mockup. Generate a SINGLE pure-white festival vendor BOOTH pictogram: front-facing square stall with a bold striped/scalloped awning, two supports and simple counter. Flat clean geometric white silhouette and thick uniform rounded strokes, about 6% of canvas width, no tiny details. True transparent background alpha. Square 512x512 if possible. Icon centered with 15% clear margin on every side, about 70% overall occupancy, readable at 28px. All visible foreground pixels pure white; transparency makes interior negative spaces. No colored pixels, gray, shadows, gradients, lighting, outlines around canvas, button plate, border, frame, words, letters, logos, watermark or decorative sparkles. One icon only.
